registration.author: Dan; implementation by Codex
registration.selection: Train only on preceding seven days. Maximize primary rate among fully covered, zero-liquidation trials. Tie-break net then canonical parameter JSON. Freeze parameters for each holdout.
registration.volatility_candidate: 100*(24h_high-24h_low)/24h_low; NOT verified as KuCoin UI definition
execution_limits: No runtime, installed scheduler, account login, order API or live recommendations.
OHLC-generated fill ledgers are simulations, not observed KuCoin trades.
Snapshot calibration cannot recover unknown original quantities or margin amendments; never fit each symbol to its target.
Both continuous and gap-aware price paths are disclosed; any liquidation fails the trial.
Missing historical books, funding, membership or candles stays explicit coverage failure.
Stop-loss closes automatically; no qualifying replacement means remain closed, not resurrect a stopped bot.
Baseline actual margins plus reserve are reported separately from the 2000-USDT two-bot portfolio.
registration.neutral_evidence: RAY: 70 grids, 140 orders, long 544 lots and short 629 lots, 17 lots per order, used 1000 plus 200 reserve; preview and post-creation states remain separate.
registration.minimum_grid_rule: Minimum >=1 USDT over the whole range after both fill fees and contract rounding. Also report margin-per-grid leveraged return percentages. The approximate RAY 50-grid centre result does not prove a full-range floor.
registration.range_exit_policy: All strategy directions close at or before 5% beyond either range edge. Prices rounded inward to valid app ticks. Unchanged historical-form baseline explicitly retains its original missing stop fields.
registration.range_selection: Causal seven-day structure, confirmed five-bar swing pivots (two closed bars on each side), ATR clipping; show supporting levels, touch counts and fallback evidence.
registration.amendment: Dan explicitly requested support/resistance ranges and a hard 5% outside-range stop after initial coverage-only negative sweep. No parameters were selected from unavailable monthly results; rerun under this amendment.

limitations: Original per-order quantity, contract risk tiers and margin amendment history absent.
Current buy plus sell order count is used as configured grid count proxy.
Mean arithmetic-grid net profit is compared with realized path-weighted average.
Full inventory stress liquidation differs from current inventory liquidation.
Running Margin is total collateral; used margin subtracts its reserved component.
No symbol-specific fitted factors or inversion of observed targets is used.

assumptions: Arithmetic equal-base-quantity intervals; current order counts proxy grid count.
Long holds the top sell-count slots with entry_i=min(initial_entry,lower_level_i).
Short mirrors long: bottom buy-count slots with entry_i=max(initial_entry,upper_level_i).
Reported unrealized PnL excludes fees and funding and belongs to precisely those slots.
Actual trade history can invalidate assumed slot inventory and its average entries.
Near-zero PnL coefficient or nonpositive inferred quantity is underidentified.
Neutral inventory cannot be inferred from net PnL and order counts alone.
Both margin interpretations use the same inferred quantity and full inventory stress.
Maintenance is estimated at 0.5%; original exchange sizing and risk tiers remain unknown.
These retrospective diagnostics do not change predictive calibration status.
